purpose: Test whether the Voynich within-word local-constraint gap survives a typologically broader, genuinely document-stratified natural-language panel.
result_blinding: No constraint metric was calculated for any panel corpus before this manifest was committed. Only eligibility, provenance, document counts, token counts, length counts, and checksums were inspected.

normalization.surface_view: Use a multiword-token header FORM once and skip its covered syntactic-word rows; otherwise use the ordinary FORM.
normalization.syntactic_view: Skip multiword-token headers and use their component syntactic-word FORMs, matching the existing language_baselines.py policy.

document_policy.boundary: Only explicit '# newdoc id = ...' markers count. Do not infer documents from sentence IDs, file splits, or topic labels.
document_policy.unassigned_tokens: Exclude every token before the first explicit newdoc marker in each file and report the count.
document_policy.sampling: For each replicate, shuffle unique document IDs without replacement using base_seed + 1000*corpus_index + replicate_index. For each document in that order, take the full primary token stream if it has at most 3,902 tokens; otherwise take a deterministic circular contiguous window of 3,902 tokens using the same RNG. Stop at exactly 39,026 tokens, truncating only the final selected contribution. Fail if the document pool is exhausted.
document_policy.reason_for_cap: No document can contribute more than 10% of a matched sample, forcing every replicate to use at least 10 genuinely distinct documents.

analysis_plan.metric: 1 - H(next character | previous character) / H(character), within tokens only, reusing statistician_pass1.py
analysis_plan.matched_sample_reporting: For both token views, report each corpus's median, minimum, maximum, and 2.5th/97.5th percentiles over 200 replicates, plus the gap from both fixed Voynich references.
analysis_plan.document_reporting: For every explicit document with at least 100 eligible tokens, report the equal-document median and IQR. This diagnoses heterogeneity but is not part of the pass/fail rule because small documents have wider estimation error.
analysis_plan.negative_control: Within each matched sample, independently shuffle characters inside every token with a separately derived fixed seed; preserve token count, token lengths, and character unigrams.
analysis_plan.pass_fail_rule: The broader-panel claim survives only if the 97.5th percentile of every corpus's primary surface-token replicate distribution remains below the lower atomic-EVA Voynich reference (0.424711). If any corpus reaches or exceeds that bound, retire the general statement that Voynich is more constrained than the broader natural-language panel and report the overlap. Literal-EVA comparisons and syntactic-token results are secondary sensitivities.
analysis_plan.interpretation_limit: Survival establishes a representation-level difference from this panel only. It does not distinguish meaningful language, cipher, stenography, or mechanically generated pseudo-text.

eligibility_stop_conditions: A pinned file checksum or license claim changes.
A corpus lacks 39,026 eligible surface tokens after explicit-document filtering.
A corpus has fewer than 20 explicit documents or fewer than 20 documents with 100 eligible surface tokens.
The implementation cannot reproduce every audit count in this manifest.
The sampling, tokenization, metric, or pass/fail rule is changed after results are inspected; such a change requires a versioned new manifest and the old result must still be reported.
